answer: One concrete mechanism: score token-distribution divergence against the identity's own answer history. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the voyage to sunk effort, uses the summit as an corroborating signal, then requires a quartz before any payout.
